run_ml_train_CO2R: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with leave-one-composition-out cross validation
run_ml_train_HER: run ML model training on HER experimental data using random forest or linear regression
run_ml_train_with_processed_df: run ML training by loading a preprocessed dataframe CSV instead of raw experimental files
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run ML training with pymatgen elemental features added to the feature set
run_ml_train_filter_matched: run ML training filtered to only XRD matched samples for higher quality predictions
